ai.title: Ask AI
ai.toggle: Ask AI from the command bar
ai.toggleHint: Type a question in the command bar and press Enter. The answer shows in the notch. Off until you turn it on.
ai.serviceHint: Use one you already have an account with.
ai.billing: The company behind {service} bills you for what you ask, not Atap. Check their prices first.
ai.keyHint: Paste the key from {service} and press Save. It stays on this PC, locked to your Windows account.
ai.keyHint.replace: To use another key, paste a new one from {service} and press Save. It replaces the saved key.
ai.keyOptional: Your own server may work without a key. Leave this empty if it does not ask for one.
ai.keyState.savedEnding: Key saved on this PC. It ends in …{end}. Atap never shows the whole key again.
ai.keyState.otherPc: The saved key is from another PC. Paste it again here.
ai.keyState.unavailable: Windows cannot lock a key on this PC, so Ask AI cannot keep one.
ai.check.notAKey: That does not look like a key. Copy it again from {service}.
ai.check.notSaved: Atap could not save the key. Try again in a moment.
ai.check.otherService: This looks like a key for {other}. Check that you picked the right service.
ai.check.free: Atap checks the key by asking for the list of models. That costs nothing.
ai.speedHint: Fast answers quickly and costs less. Smarter takes a little longer and costs more.
ai.ownServerHint: For a model you run yourself, such as Ollama. It must understand the OpenAI chat format.
ai.serverBad: Type a full address that starts with http:// or https://.
ai.serverPlain: This address uses http, so your key crosses your home network unlocked. Use https if your server has it.
ai.modelHint: Leave empty to use Fast or Smarter. Or type a model name from the service, such as {example}.
ai.modelBad: A model name has only letters, numbers and . _ - : / @
ai.privacy: Only what you type goes to {service}, and only when you press Enter. Copied text goes only if you tick Include what I copied.
ai.row.setup: Set up Ask AI in Settings
ai.copiedNone: There is no copied text right now.
ai.capped: The answer was very long, so it stops here.
ai.chat.title: Ask AI chat
ai.chat.placeholder: Type a message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
ai.chat.empty: Ask anything. Each chat keeps its own conversation. Chats go when Atap closes.
ai.chat.setup: Add your key for Ask AI in Settings first.
ai.error.key: {service} did not accept your key. Check it in Settings.
ai.error.credit: Your {service} account is out of credit. Top it up on their site.
ai.error.limit: You have reached your {service} limit for now. Try again in a little while.
ai.error.model: That model is not available on {service}. Pick Fast or Smarter in Settings.
ai.error.busy: {service} is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
ai.error.time: No answer in time. Try again.
ai.error.offline: You are offline, so nothing was sent.
ai.error.server: Atap cannot reach your server. Check that it is running.
ai.error.reach: Atap cannot reach {service}. Check your internet.
ai.error.notAllowed: Atap did not send this. Plain http works only on this PC or your own network, and Atap never follows a redirect.
ai.error.unexpected: {service} sent something Atap could not read. Try again.
